generate_h2_header_frame: generate an HPACK-encoded HTTP/2 header frame from colon-separated headers piped to stdin
run_with_hex_output: run the script with --hex flag to output header frame bytes as a C-style hex array
run_with_compression: run the script with --compression pre to use pre-indexed HPACK encoding for headers
run_with_end_stream: run the script with --set_end_stream flag to set the END_STREAM flag on the header frame
run_without_framing: run the script with --no_framing flag to output only HPACK payload without HTTP/2 frame header
